children: The Federal Trade Commission filed an amended complaint adding ten states as co-plaintiffs in a lawsuit alleging that Dollar General Corporation engaged in long-running deceptive pricing practices by routinely charging customers more at the register than the prices displayed on shelves, price tags and advertisements, costing consumers millions of dollars.
